thirtyMinutes.title: 30 minutes over Zoom
thirtyMinutes.body: A focused call at a time that suits you. Camera optional — whatever you're comfortable with.

freeNoObligation.title: Free, with no obligation
freeNoObligation.body: No invoice and no commitment. If I'm not the right fit, I'll say so and point you elsewhere.

whereLosingTime.title: A look at where you're losing time and money
whereLosingTime.body: Walk me through the workflow that frustrates you most. I'll dig into what it's really costing you.

honestAnswer.title: An honest answer on whether custom software is worth it
honestAnswer.body: Sometimes the right move is a small fix — or nothing at all. I'll tell you straight, either way.

expectations.title: What to expect on the call
expectations.lede: It's a conversation, not a pitch. Here's exactly how the 30 minutes go.

preparation.title: Come as you are
